sections.heading: What is Prathibimba?
sections.content: The B7G Kannada Rajyotsava 2026 celebration is titled Prathibimba — Our Heritage. Our Story. It runs over two days, 31 October and 1 November 2026, at Brigade 7 Gardens. Everyone is welcome. Posters for both days, in English and Kannada, are in the Programmes section of the website.

sections.heading: 31 October 2026 — evening programme highlights
sections.content:
The 31 October 2026 programme runs from 5 PM to 10 PM at Brigade 7 Gardens.
- Kannada film actor Nagabhushana NS joins the evening.
- Performances by B7G residents: singing, dance, drama and dance drama.
- Evening highlight: live sand art by Mr. Raghavendra Hegde, a renowned sand artist.

sections.heading: 1 November 2026 — programme highlights
sections.content:
The 1 November 2026 programme begins at 9 AM at Brigade 7 Gardens.
- Chief Guests: Mr. Prakash Belawadi and Mr. Dharmendra Kumar (Dharmi).
- B7G Santhe: food stalls run by B7G residents.
- Evening highlights: Hulivesha (Huli Kunita) and a live band / jamming.
